name: Iron + Engine
subtitle: 4-week hypertrophy block · upper / lower split
lede: Four training days a week. Every session starts with weights and finishes with cardio, so the lifting gets your freshest effort and the cardio builds your heart without eating into muscle gain.

weeks.name: Week 1
weeks.note: Pick loads you could lift 3 more reps with (RIR 3). Learn the movements and set your baselines.

weeks.name: Week 2
weeks.note: Add load or reps on every lift. Stop 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2).

weeks.name: Week 3
weeks.note: Hardest week. +1 set on the first two lifts, stop 1 rep short of failure (RIR 1).

weeks.name: Week 4
weeks.note: Recovery week. Half the sets, same loads as Week 1, RIR 4. All cardio stays easy Zone 2. Then restart Week 1 with heavier weights.

Never go hard here; Monday's session matters more

days.title: Rest
items: Plan meals for the week and prep protein
Check your logged loads and set Monday's targets

rules: When you hit the top of the rep range on every set, add 2.5 kg to upper-body lifts or 5 kg to lower-body lifts next session.
Around 130–175 g a day at 80 kg, split over 3–5 meals with 30–40 g each.
A small daily surplus over maintenance. Aim to gain 0.25–0.5% of body weight per week.
Most of the growth happens here. Short sleep stalls strength and recovery faster than anything else.
Kept short and placed after lifting. Easy Zone 2 after leg days, short intervals after upper days.
How many more clean reps you could have done. RIR 2 means you stopped two reps short of failure.
